page_title: MON 3-2 HEI | B. Monchengladbach v Heidenheim 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+6' A pass travels right across the box to Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller denies him with a decent save.
90+6' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
90+4' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Kevin Muller makes a smart save to deny him.
90+3' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alassane Plea will be replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
90' Here is a change. Joe Scally is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
89' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Moritz Nicolas.
88' What was Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
85' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Rocco Reitz.
83' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
81' Robin Hack comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Franck Honorat.
81' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Benedikt Gimber is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
81' The substitution has been made. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) has replaced Marnon Busch.
80' 3 - 2 Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Moritz Nicolas to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
80' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
80' It’s a PENALTY to Heidenheim after the VAR review!
78' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Siebert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Heidenheim using VAR. This could be interesting!
75' 3 - 1 Goal! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) takes a long run up and buries the penalty into the bottom right corner.
75' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' One of the Heidenheim players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to B. Monchengladbach.
73' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner which is cleared.

73' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Kevin Muller sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
71' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Paul Wanner departs the field of play to be replaced by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim).
68' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Leo Scienza and he is replaced by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim).
67' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.
65' Referee Daniel Siebert points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The B. Monchengladbach players celebrate.
64' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The B. Monchengladbach players aren’t happy.
62' 2 - 1 GOAL! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Alassane Plea provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 2:1.
59' Adrian Beck goes off the pitch and Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) comes on.
58' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
53' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
52' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
49' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) works the corner short.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
41' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but it's cleared.
39' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
38' Shots on target – 4:2.
35' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
34' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) sends an accurate pass to Marnon Busch, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
31' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Heidenheim out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
31' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Siebert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
28' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
27' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
27' A header by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Kevin Muller, who makes a brilliant save.

25' That didn't go as planned! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Kevin Muller, who easily kept it out.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
21' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
19' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
17' The game is interrupted now, Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' The B. Monchengladbach players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
9' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
6' Heidenheim are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
4' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) stretches for the loose ball inside the box and rifles a volley just over the bar.
3' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Heidenheim will kick the game off.
Daniel Siebert is the one to supervise the game today.
